blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Pitt Meadows total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in South Meadows fell from 14 in June to 11 in September, and 12 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 29.7% of Pitt Meadows’s 37 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in South Meadows?
South Meadows also had 13 condos and townhomes listed and 3 sold in September, against 11 houses listed. The South Meadows condos and townhomes page has those figures.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in South Meadows?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 11 houses listed in South Meadows. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is South Meadows a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in South Meadows had a sales ratio of 45%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in South Meadows from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 12 houses sold in South Meadows over those 4 months, out of 37 in all of Pitt Meadows.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in South Meadows?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
